ios.desc:
PixFace allows you to hide UNLIMITED faces in photos just with 1 tap! 
PixFace detects faces in photos for you automatically and you just need to select which face to hide - pixellate. 
Its simple and useful interface allows to edit and save/share photos just in several seconds and saves your valuable time.

FEATURES

• PixFace offers 3 different filters:
    - Low size 
    - Medium size
    - Big size
You may need different filter intensity - pixel size in different photos and PixFace helps to accomplish this.

• Unlimited faces
    - PixFace's AI powered engine allows you to hide unlimited faces in photos

Download PixFace and get powerful, simple, useful app in your pocket!

PixFace Premium Subscription

Get unlimited full access to all PixFace face filters and remove watermark from edited images. Save privacy in your photos.


Subscription prices may vary depending on your country of residence and may be converted to your local currency.


Payment for your subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account after purchase confirmation. Your subscription will automatically renew and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off the auto-renewal at any time in your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of a subscription period.


Read about Terms of Use here: https://pixface.app/terms

Read about Privacy Policy here: https://pixface.app/privacypolicy
